g.text: beam size 2: keep the two best partial hypotheses at every step

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Scores are cumulative log-probabilities — every one is negative, so a longer hypothesis is penalised purely for being

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: longer. Dividing by length^0.6 before the final comparison corrects that; without it beam search systematically truncates.
